objective: Decision 0106, rules: in a run's fight clicks add strikes (the team's own attacks slower, a click is the next animal's strike on the front line) and each animal's power attack has a quick press (ring, needle, chain, mash) that decides its Perfect; the HUD answers clicks at once and draws each press.
acceptance_criteria: With Setup.clicks the team's own attacks are CLICK_SLOW times slower and a tap on BattleRules.STRIKE strikes with the next standing animal in turn, at most once per STRIKE_GAP, filling its meter by the same share
BattleRules.pressOf gives each species and variant its press (a Titan mashes) and BattleRules.perfect judges ring, needle, chain and mash
A strike changes nothing before its time, so the fight still replays from the start with each click
The strike remote takes a batch of clicks (cost 0.5) and lays them from TAP_AHEAD ahead; power takes a mash's presses, capped by MASH_RATE on the server's clock
The HUD answers a click at once (a slash, a tick, the hit count) and draws the needle, the chain's marks and the mash's count on the plates; click hits are drawn lighter
verification: lune run tests/run (BattleRules, WaveRuns); a run fought in Studio clicking, with each press tried.
notes: SHANNON, 2026-11-22, on the concept canvas's Pit boards: "i like this pit concept with the multipl QTE can you implement stages and the gate waking up the four press types"; "it should be a tapping fight where you click to attack and do QTEs and stuff" (picked: clicks add strikes, board first); "clicking should only target the front lane not any specific target"; "please implement it into the game". Checkpoint (decision 0106): CLICK_SLOW 2.4 and STRIKE_SECONDS 0.6 (about 4 clicks a second matches the old damage), NEEDLE_EVERY 1.2, MASH_COUNT 10 by MASH_BY 3.2, which variants press differently. Known: a strike lands TAP_AHEAD after its click, like every tap (decision 0092).
